page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-88-highlssd is a storage-optimized instance engineered for data-heavy enterprise applications. Driven by x86_64 Intel Xeon 8481C processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz, the server delivers 88 dedicated vCPUs across 44 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The CPU architecture incorporates 105 MB of L3 cache alongside specialized instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel AMX matrix multiplication acceleration. System memory is provisioned at 704 GB, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU memory profile, while the storage subsystem features 38,652 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD capacity across 12 drives.

Benchmark data reflects strong parallel execution and memory capabilities. The instance achieved 18,436 in Geekbench multi-core and 72,975.63 in stress-ng multi-core testing, placing it in the top quartile of evaluated systems. In data structure testing, it recorded 80.68 million Redis SET operations per second and scored strongly in PassMark database operations. Large-block memory bandwidth demonstrated 226.47 GB/sec during uncached reads and 99.47 GB/sec for writes. In contrast to its multi-threaded throughput, single-threaded processing falls within the median category, registering a 1,704 Geekbench single-core score and a 1,622.29 stress-ng single-core score.

By coupling high core counts and a 1:8 compute-to-memory ratio with over 38 terabytes of bundled NVMe storage, this server minimizes network storage latency and eliminates peripheral drive overhead. A notable operational tradeoff is its baseline single-core performance, which shifts processing efficiency toward parallelized routines rather than thread-isolated execution. The hardware profile is optimal for distributed relational and NoSQL databases, transactional processing, extensive in-memory caching layers, search clusters, and large-scale ETL pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-88-highlssd is a storage-optimized server designed for high-density I/O and large memory footprints. Operating on the x86_64 architecture with 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8481C processors, it supplies 88 dedicated vCPUs across 44 physical cores, 105 MB of L3 cache, and AVX-512 plus AMX instruction extensions. The configuration includes 704 GB of RAM, offering 8 GB per vCPU, and integrates 38,652 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD storage across 12 local drives. Benchmark testing demonstrates strong multi-core capacity with a Geekbench multi-core result of 18,436 and 80.68 million Redis SET operations per second, alongside 226.47 GB/sec large-block read memory bandwidth, offset by middle-tier single-core performance. This dense hardware profile eliminates network storage bottlenecks, making it suited for large distributed databases, in-memory caching engines, transactional data processing, and large-scale analytics platforms.
